title: Sunder #2
desc: The arrival of the magical book finally sends Zeek on his very first adventure; to find the rightful owner of this mysterious book. After a long conversation, it is decided that he should go into town where an old friend of the Abbott, the owner of the apothecary, might know the whereabouts of an old Wizard who supposedly used to live nearby. All the while, on the other side of the galaxy, other sinister forces are at play. An ancient creature has been looking for that book for a very long time. Now that it has resurfaced, the creature known as Mollock is back on the hunt for it!
